label: pipeline_20_v2
description: 20-prompt tight pipeline eval. Fresh tickers and wordings; same shape coverage as pipeline_50 but distilled. NO event triggers. Tests whether the over-confirmation-prose fix lands.

prompts.prompt: buy 18 ETERNAL when RSI(14)<33 AND MACD hist > 0. Sell 6 at +3%, sell 6 more at +6%, sell rest if drawdown from peak >= 5% OR held > 25 bars
long 14 HINDALCO on Keltner upper band cross. Sell 7 when up 4%, sell 7 more if price drops below entry_price minus 2x ATR(14)
buy 10 DIXON when 50 EMA crosses above 200 EMA. Sell 5 at +5%, then trail an 8% stop on the remaining 5 from peak unrealised
every Tuesday at 10am buy 8 BANKBEES. If BANKNIFTY drops 2% intraday from open sell 12 of my BANKBEES holding. On the last Friday of every month squareoff my full BANKBEES position
watch ICICIBANK: when RSI<28 buy 6 shares; when MACD hist crosses above zero buy 4 more; when RSI rises above 72 sell 10
every weekday 5 minutes after market open buy 3 GAIL. Every weekday 10 minutes before market close sell 3 GAIL. If RSI on GAIL rises above 75 anytime, sell 6 more
when DRREDDY RSI drops below 30 buy 5 shares; separately when CIPLA RSI drops below 30 buy 6 shares; each leg exits independently once its position is up 4%
every weekday at 09:35 check ONGC: if RSI<32 AND price is above 20 EMA notify me. If also MACD hist > 0, buy 12 ONGC shares
every hour during market check my BAJAJFINSV position: notify me if it's drawn down more than 4% from peak. If drawdown exceeds 7%, sell half my BAJAJFINSV holding at market
every weekday at 15:20 evaluate INDUSINDBK: notify me if MACD line is above signal AND price is above the 50 EMA. If RSI is also below 40, buy 4 INDUSINDBK at market
buy 10 ASIANPAINT when (RSI(14) < 36 AND MACD hist > 0 AND price above 100 EMA AND volume > 1.5x 20-day avg). Exit when (RSI > 73 OR drawdown from peak >= 6% OR bars held > 28)
long 12 TATAMOTORS when ATR(14) is in the bottom 20% of its 252-bar distribution AND price > 50 EMA. Exit when (price drops below entry_price - 2x ATR OR drawdown from peak > 5%)
buy 8 BHARTIARTL when RSI dropped below 32 within the last 6 bars AND price is now above the 20 EMA. Trail a 7% stop from peak unrealised gain
ONLY on Mondays AND Tuesdays buy 14 ITC when MACD hist > 0 AND price > 20 EMA. Sell 7 when up 3%, sell 7 more when up 6% OR after 10 bars held
every Friday only, if HCLTECH RSI<40 AND TCS RSI<40 buy 5 HCLTECH and 5 TCS. Each leg exits when its position is up 4% OR after 8 bars held
buy 7 KOTAKBANK when KOTAKBANK/HDFCBANK ratio drops below 0.42 AND today's KOTAKBANK volume is greater than 1.5x its 20-day average. Sell 4 at +3%, sell 3 more if the ratio recovers above 0.48
on Wednesdays AND Thursdays only, when the 60-day correlation between SUNPHARMA and DRREDDY is above 0.7 AND SUNPHARMA RSI<32 buy 8 SUNPHARMA. Exit when correlation drops below 0.5 OR position up 4%
buy 12 NTPC when RSI<32. Wait 30 minutes, then if NTPC is still above entry set a 2% trailing stop, otherwise sell at market
for each of my current holdings up more than 12% from average buy price, sell 30% of that position at market
watch 3 conditions on MARUTI: RSI drops below 30, price gaps down 2% intraday, volume > 2x avg. If at least 2 of these happen on the same day, buy 4 MARUTI
